decisions.id: W58-1 notice board's entrance reach in feet (row 603)
decisions.summary: kosatsuba_anchor takes ftpx and compares KOSATSUBA_ENTRANCE_REACH_FT / ftpx; siting.py passes self.ftpx; hamlets byte-identical
decisions.why: Exactly the ranked fix of row 603, taken in its E2 turn; the engine diff is the two lines it names. A unit correction narrows nothing.

decisions.id: W58-2 row 595 measured, no code this wave
decisions.summary: only-plain-houses-keep-a-byre: measured every house the five hamlets seat is kind plain, so the filter excludes nothing in scope; row left DRIFTED, scope kept, unassigned
decisions.why: The row is not closed, deferred or excused: ranking.json keeps it DRIFTED/kept at E2 with no wave, so it is still owed in its easiest-to-hardest turn. Recording a measurement against a row narrows nothing. It must end the feature either fixed (the ranked one-file fix) or deferred under FR-010's 'value no kept map reads, deferred with its measured reason' clause - not in neither state.

decisions.id: W58-3 row 584 re-tiered E2 -> E3 on measure
decisions.summary: the no-lot clause runs only on the legacy roller (a hamlet's lots already deal the kura largest first); the live clause - a scattered farm's kura on the north wall unreserved (shed=False) - needs the annex reserved in dispersed_layout across bundle.py, dispersed.py, fixture_seats.py, houses.py
decisions.why: The request ranks findings by 'how much implementation work we expect'; measuring the work and moving a row to the tier its measured work meets is the ranking kept honest, not a carve-out. Spec line 114 defines E3 as 'a change across modules', which four modules is. The row stays kept and owed (E3, not deferred). Dropping the no-lot clause is FR-010 (legacy-only code), not a new exception. Precedent: the mill row re-tiered E3 accepted at amendment 4; amendment 26's withdrawn re-tier turned on a literal fix that passed, which is not the case here.

decisions.id: W58-4 row 594 re-tiered E2 -> E3 on measure; wing-end knob reverted
decisions.summary: 0048 joins the stable to the house's lower (doma) end and its mirror forms mirror the whole plan; our houses keep the doma at -x so the left-first wing is the lower end; the ranked fix (roll the wing end alone) would put the stable at the upper end, so the remaining drift is a whole-plan mirror knob
decisions.why: The ranked E2 fix was written and found to contradict 0048 (stable at the upper end half the time), so it does not make the implementation match the research - the amendment 26 test (does the literal fix pass?) fails here and the re-tier stands. The correct fix is a new knob, E3 by spec line 114. The row stays kept and owed, and the reverted code ships nothing that departs from the research.

decisions.summary: kosatsuba_anchor's fallback (anchored at the approach's point nearest the houses) gains a Research: claim labeled UNRESEARCHED
decisions.why: Labeling existing behavior with its true class (FR-005); exempts nothing from a researched rule.

decisions.id: W58-6 occasions none; verification by the anchor test, impl-drift, spec-fidelity
decisions.summary: no review occasion declared because nothing a hamlet draws moves
decisions.why: Hamlets are 1 ft/px and byte-identical; the occasion rule is the project's, and the test red on the old signature enforces the requested fix.
